responsibility: Declares the public alias-analysis interface implemented in alias.cc. It provides constructors and queries for GCC alias sets, helpers for recording subset/component relationships, tree and RTL conflict predicates, TBAA-oriented pointer/reference compatibility helpers, and the special ALIAS_SET_MEMORY_BARRIER constant used to force conservative memory conflicts across optimization boundaries.
same_name_distinction: Declares the exported alias-analysis interface and constants used by the rest of GCC; unlike gcc/alias.cc, it does not implement alias-set construction, conflict decisions, or the per-function alias-analysis algorithms.
